# Julian David Urrego Lancheros — AI Implementation & Data Science Specialist

> Senior Data Scientist and AI Implementation Specialist based in Bogotá, Colombia, serving clients across Latin America (Colombia, Mexico, Chile, Argentina), Brazil, Spain, and the United States. 6+ years experience in Marketing Science, LLM Agents, Google Cloud BigQuery, Text-to-SQL architecture, and executive business intelligence.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **Enterprise BigQuery AI Agents**: Production-ready Text-to-SQL agents connected to Google Cloud BigQuery and Snowflake for marketing and media teams. Built with semantic abstraction layers, deterministic guardrails, dry-run cost verification (<$0.003/query), and strict read-only IAM security.
- **Marketing Science & Predictive Modeling**: Media Mix Modeling (MMM), incremental attribution, customer lifetime value (LTV), churn prediction, and custom ad-tech algorithms.
- **Executive BI & Automated Reporting**: Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, and automated Python ETL pipelines integrating Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, and GA4 data.
- **Consulting & Implementation**: Architecture audit, LLM evaluation (Gemini vs ChatGPT benchmarks), prompt engineering, and end-to-end deployment for agencies, scale-ups, and corporate brands.

## Geographic Coverage & Languages
- **Regions Served**: Colombia, Mexico, Chile, Brazil, Spain, USA, and Global Remote.
- **Languages**: Spanish (Native), English (Professional Working), Portuguese (Professional Working).
